public_state.prompt: Reach the resident. Use arrow keys and the eye to inspect both faces, cross seams deliberately, and use Shift only when opening a fire on your chosen route.

rules.fire: A marked fire blocks its cell until you face it and use one extinguisher. Choose a route whose fire cost fits the stock.
rules.inspection: The eye reveals the other face without moving the firefighter.
rules.ladder: UP and DOWN work only at a visible ladder connection.
rules.movement: Arrow keys move one cell; walking past either floor edge crosses to the other face.

server_grade.feedback: resident reached; face inspections 1; fires cleared 4; extinguishers left 0; actions 48
